## Checklist

- [ ] One item per JSON file, in the right folder, named `<id>.json`
- [ ] `id` is kebab-case and not already used
- [ ] `author` is my GitHub handle
- [ ] `source` is `"homebrew"` and `edition` is `"5e"`
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/build-index.mjs --check` and it passed (or I'm relying on the automatic check)
- [ ] I did **not** edit `index.json` (it's rebuilt automatically after merge)
- [ ] Maps only: the image is under 5 MB and sits in `maps/` next to its JSON file

## Rules

- [ ] This is my own original work, or I have the right to share it under CC BY 4.0 (credit given in `credits`)
- [ ] It contains no copyrighted text from non-SRD books (no copying from the PHB, Xanathar's, Tasha's, etc.)
- [ ] It is family-friendly
- [ ] I agree to license this content under CC BY 4.0
